environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) A custom rule with ByteMatchStatement targeting QUERY_STRING with TextTransformation URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE applied, matching on patterns including UNION, SELECT, single-quote ('), double-dash (--), semicolon (;), with positional constraint CONTAINS, action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents (task cannot reach any other AWS service). CloudWatch Logs Insights query runs every 5 minutes alerting on HTTP 500 responses.

waf_rules.name: custom-sqli-deep-inspection
waf_rules.statement: ByteMatch on QUERY_STRING with URL_DECODE + HTML_ENTITY_DECODE transforms, CONTAINS patterns: ["UNION", "union", "SELECT", "select", "'", "--", ";", "/*", "*/", "CHAR(", "char(", "0x"]

config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights alert on 5xx every 5min
